ambiguities.text: The meta-EIP does not specify the exact interaction order between the bundled EIPs if they affect the same operation.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume each EIP is independently applied during its respective phase (signature validation for EIP-155, execution for EIP-160/161, deployment for EIP-170).

ambiguities.text: The relationship between 'Spurious Dragon' and 'State-clearing' alias is mentioned but their semantic equivalence is not explicit.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'State-clearing' is a descriptive alias referring to EIP-161's primary function, and both names refer to the same fork.

implicit_assumptions.description: All node operators upgrade their clients before block 2,675,000 to support Spurious Dragon rules.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Non-upgraded nodes will fork off onto an incompatible chain, causing network splits and potential double-spend opportunities.

implicit_assumptions.description: The bundled EIPs (155, 160, 161, 170) have been thoroughly tested and are mutually compatible.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Unexpected interactions between EIPs could cause consensus failures or exploitable edge cases.
